title: Collecting
question: What in particular does a person gain when he or she becomes a serious collector?

meanings.usage: 指大量收集或积聚财物、信息等
指个人拥有的物品，常用复数形式

meanings.meaning: 不加选择的，漫不经心的
meanings.usage: 形容不加区分地收集或对待事物
指杂乱无章的物品堆放
指对事物的感伤情绪或情感因素
形容善于节省金钱或资源的人
指做某事所必需的东西
指对某事的极度热爱或沉迷
指简短的绘画或文字描述
cut out sketches表示剪下图片
指休闲娱乐活动或放松状态
指珍视的收藏品或贵重物品
指通过查证来确认信息的准确性
指用于展示或研究的典型例子
指对现状感到满意的状态
指让人感到无聊或厌烦
boredom是名词形式，表示厌烦的状态

examples.en: People tend to amass possessions, sometimes without being aware of doing so.
examples.zh: 人们往往会积聚财产，有时甚至没有意识到自己在这样做。

examples.en: Both physical and mental energy are essential in turning out and throwing away.
examples.zh: 体力和脑力对于清理和扔掉东西都是必不可少的。

examples.en: I know someone who always cuts sketches out from newspapers.
examples.zh: 我认识一个人，她总是从报纸上剪下时装图样。

examples.en: It is a harmless habit, but it litters up her desk to such an extent.
examples.zh: 这是个无害的习惯，但它把她的桌子弄得乱七八糟。

examples.en: There is always something to do in connection with it.
examples.zh: 与此相关的总有事情可做。

examples.en: This hobby educates one not only in the chosen subject, but also in general matters which have some bearing on it.
examples.zh: 这种爱好不仅使人对自己选择的主题有所了解，而且还能使人了解与之相关的一般性知识。

examples.en: One wants to meet like-minded collectors, to get advice, to compare notes.
examples.zh: 人们想遇到志趣相投的收藏家，获取建议，交流心得。

examples.en: One wants to meet like-minded collectors, to compare notes, to exchange articles, to show off the latest find.
examples.zh: 人们想遇到志趣相投的收藏家，交流心得，交换物品，展示最新发现。

examples.en: Perhaps a trip abroad in search of a rare specimen.
examples.zh: 或许还会出国寻找珍稀标本。

phrases.usage: 多年来，随着时间的推移

examples.en: Over the years, one may well become an authority on one's hobby.
examples.zh: 多年下来，人很可能会成为自己爱好的权威。

sentences.en: People tend to amass possessions, sometimes without being aware of doing so.
sentences.zh: 人们倾向于积累财产，有时甚至没有意识到自己在这样做。

sentences.en: Indeed they can have a delightful surprise when they find something useful which they did not know they owned.
sentences.zh: 事实上，当他们发现一些自己并不知道拥有的有用物品时，他们会感到惊喜。

sentences.en: Those who never have to move house become indiscriminate collectors of what can only be described as clutter.
sentences.zh: 那些从不搬家的人成了不加选择的收藏者，而他们的收藏只能被称为杂物。

sentences.en: They leave unwanted objects in drawers, cupboards and attics for years, in the belief that they may one day need just those very things.
sentences.zh: 他们把不用的东西放在抽屉、碗柜和阁楼上好多年，相信总有一天会用上这些东西。

sentences.en: As they grow old, people also accumulate belongings for two other reasons,
sentences.zh: 随着年龄的增长，人们还因为另外两个原因而积累物品：

sentences.en: lack of physical and mental energy, both of which are essential in turning out and throwing away, and sentiment.
sentences.zh: 缺少清理和扔掉东西所必需的体力和精力，以及情感因素。

sentences.en: Things owned for a long time are full of associations with the past,
sentences.zh: 拥有了很久的东西，充满了与过去的联系，

sentences.en: perhaps with relatives who are dead, and so they gradually acquire a value beyond their true worth.
sentences.zh: 也许与已故的亲人有关，因此它们逐渐获得超出其真实价值的价值。

sentences.en: Some things are collected deliberately in the home in an attempt to avoid waste.
sentences.zh: 有些东西是人们为了避免浪费而特意在家中收藏的。

sentences.en: Among these I would list string and brown paper,
sentences.zh: 在这些东西中，我会列举麻线和牛皮纸，

sentences.en: kept by thrifty people when a parcel has been opened, to save buying these two requisites.
sentences.zh: 节俭的人在包裹拆开后会把它们留下，以节省购买这两种必需品的钱。

sentences.en: Collecting small items can easily become a mania.
sentences.zh: 收集小物品很容易变成一种癖好。

sentences.en: I know someone who always cuts sketches out from newspapers of model clothes that she would like to buy if she had the money.
sentences.zh: 我认识一个人，她总是从报纸上剪下她有钱就想买的服装款式图。

sentences.en: As she is not rich, the chances that she will ever be able to afford such purchases are remote;
sentences.zh: 由于她不富裕，她将来能买得起这些东西的可能性很小；

sentences.en: but she is never sufficiently strongminded to be able to stop the practice.
sentences.zh: 但她从没有足够的毅力来停止这种做法。

sentences.en: It is a harmless habit, but it litters up her desk to such an extent that every time she opens it, loose bits of paper fall out in every direction.
sentences.zh: 这是一种无害的习惯，但它把她的书桌弄得一团糟，以至于她每次打开书桌，散乱的纸片都会四处掉落。

sentences.en: Collecting as a serious hobby is quite different and has many advantages.
sentences.zh: 作为一种严肃的爱好，收藏就完全不同了，它有很多优点。

sentences.en: It provides relaxation for leisure hours, as just looking at one's treasures is always a joy.
sentences.zh: 它为闲暇时间提供了放松，因为仅仅看着自己的珍藏就是一种乐趣。

sentences.en: One does not have to go outside for amusement, since the collection is housed at home.
sentences.zh: 人不必外出寻找乐趣，因为藏品就放在家里。

sentences.en: Whatever it consists of, stamps, records, first editions of books, china, glass,
sentences.zh: 无论是邮票、唱片、书籍初版、瓷器、玻璃制品、

sentences.en: antique furniture, pictures, model cars, stuffed birds, toy animals, there is always something to do in connection with it,
sentences.zh: 古董家具、画作、模型汽车、填充鸟类、玩具动物，总有与它相关的事情可做，

sentences.en: from finding the right place for the latest addition, to verifying facts in reference books.
sentences.zh: 从为最新藏品找到合适的位置，到在参考书中核实事实。

sentences.en: This hobby educates one not only in the chosen subject, but also in general matters which have some bearing on it.
sentences.zh: 这种爱好不仅能让人们在所选的领域受到教育，还能在与此相关的一般事务上学到知识。

sentences.en: There are also other benefits.
sentences.zh: 还有其他好处。

sentences.en: One wants to meet like-minded collectors, to get advice, to compare notes, to exchange articles, to show off the latest find.
sentences.zh: 人们会想结识志同道合的收藏家，以获取建议、交流心得、交换物品、炫耀最新的发现。

sentences.en: So one's circle of friends grows.
sentences.zh: 这样一来，朋友圈子就扩大了。

sentences.en: Soon the hobby leads to travel, perhaps to a meeting in another town,
sentences.zh: 很快，这项爱好就会带来旅行，也许是去另一个城市参加会议，

sentences.en: possibly a trip abroad in search of a rare specimen, for collectors are not confined to any one country.
sentences.zh: 也可能是出国旅行寻找稀有标本，因为收藏家并不局限于某个国家。

sentences.en: Over the years, one may well become an authority on one's hobby and will very probably be asked to give informal talks to little gatherings
sentences.zh: 多年以后，人们很可能成为自己爱好领域的权威人士，并且很可能会被邀请在小型聚会上做非正式的演讲，

sentences.en: and then, if successful, to larger audiences.
sentences.zh: 然后，如果成功，还会面向更多的听众。

sentences.en: In this way self-confidence grows, first from mastering a subject, then from being able to talk about it.
sentences.zh: 这样，自信心就会增长，首先是掌握了一门学科，然后是能够谈论它。

sentences.en: Collecting, by occupying spare time so constructively, makes a person contented, with no time for boredom.
sentences.zh: 收藏，通过如此建设性地占据了业余时间，使人感到满足，没有时间感到无聊。

grammar.title: What引导的特殊疑问句
grammar.definition: What引导的特殊疑问句用于询问具体的信息，回答不是简单的yes或no
grammar.structure: What + 助动词 + 主语 + 动词...? / What in particular + 助动词 + 主语 + 动词...?
grammar.usage: what in particular用于强调询问具体的方面或细节，相当于specifically或particularly

examples.en: What in particular does a person gain when he or she becomes a serious collector?
examples.zh: 当一个人成为一个认真的收藏家时，他或她究竟会得到什么？

examples.en: What do you usually collect?
examples.zh: 你通常收集什么？

grammar.title: As引导的时间状语从句
grammar.definition: As引导的时间状语从句，表示'随着'或'当...时候'，主句和从句的动作同时发生
grammar.structure: As + 主语 + 动词..., 主语 + 动词...
grammar.usage: as表示时间的流逝或情况的改变，常与表示变化的动词连用，如grow old, change等

examples.en: As they grow old, people also accumulate belongings for two other reasons.
examples.zh: 随着人们年龄的增长，他们还因为另外两个原因积攒东西。

examples.en: As time goes by, his collection grows larger.
examples.zh: 随着时间的推移，他的收藏越来越大。

grammar.title: But连接的并列句
grammar.definition: but作为并列连词连接两个意义相反或对照的并列分句
grammar.usage: but连接的句子强调前后意思的转折或对比，前面不用句号而用逗号

examples.en: It is a harmless habit, but it litters up her desk to such an extent.
examples.zh: 这是个无害的习惯，但它把她的桌子弄得乱七八糟。

examples.en: She would like to buy them if she had the money, but she is not rich.
examples.zh: 如果她有钱的话她想买这些衣服，但她不富有。

patterns.pattern: What + 助动词 + 主语 + gain/benefit + when...?

original.en: What in particular does a person gain when he or she becomes a serious collector?
original.zh: 当一个人成为一个认真的收藏家时，他或她究竟会得到什么？

examples.en: What in particular does one learn when taking up a new hobby?
examples.zh: 当一个人开始一个新的爱好时，他究竟会学到什么？

examples.en: What in particular do people feel when they retire?
examples.zh: 当人们退休时，他们究竟会有什么感受？

patterns.pattern: People/主语 + tend to + 动词原形

original.en: People tend to amass possessions, sometimes without being aware of doing so.
original.zh: 人们往往会积聚财产，有时甚至没有意识到自己在这样做。

examples.en: Students tend to put off their assignments until the last minute.
examples.zh: 学生们往往会拖延作业直到最后一刻。

examples.en: Children tend to be more curious about the world around them.
examples.zh: 孩子们往往对周围的世界更加好奇。

patterns.pattern: As + 主语 + 动词, 主语 + 动词...

original.en: As they grow old, people also accumulate belongings for two other reasons.
original.zh: 随着人们年龄的增长，他们还因为另外两个原因积攒东西。

examples.en: As she became more experienced, she started to travel alone.
examples.zh: 随着她变得越来越有经验，她开始独自旅行。

examples.en: As technology advances, our lives become more convenient.
examples.zh: 随着技术的进步，我们的生活变得更加便利。

patterns.pattern: There is always something to + 动词

original.en: There is always something to do in connection with it.
original.zh: 与此相关的总有事情可做。

examples.en: There is always something to learn from every experience.
examples.zh: 从每一次经历中总有东西可学。

examples.en: There is always something to improve in our work.
examples.zh: 在我们的工作中总有可以改进的地方。
